speaker: Doctor
text: The thrombocytosis and abnormal platelets on the smear are highly suggestive of a myeloproliferative neoplasm, likely Essential Thrombocythemia. Do you have any history of headaches, visual disturbances, or previous blood clots?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

speaker: Doctor
text: The digital pain improving with cold is a classic sign of erythromelalgia, which, combined with your thrombocytosis, strongly points to Essential Thrombocythemia. To confirm this diagnosis, we need to rule out other causes of secondary thrombocytosis and check for the JAK2 mutation. REQUEST TEST: JAK2 V617F mutation analysis, Serum Ferritin, Inflammatory Markers (CRP/ESR).
